field_principles.active_constraint_sparse_repair_ready: interface readiness gate, not a performance headline.
field_principles.descriptor_path: points to the executable sparse block descriptor payload.
field_principles.exact_fallback_used: keeps exact validators as the acceptance authority.
field_principles.fixture_paths: names the exact-checkable hard/soft fixtures used by every policy.
field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal status; start with complete: or blocked: and do not claim speedup.
field_principles.inference_substrate: declares exact-checked sparse repair, no model training or live inference.
field_principles.mean_iterations_exact_only: iteration evidence for the exact-only baseline.
field_principles.mean_iterations_sparse_repair: iteration evidence for sparse repair; not a speedup claim.
field_principles.random_block_success_rate: same-size random block control under exact checking.
field_principles.sparse_block_policy: names the non-trained block-selection rule after violations.
field_principles.sparse_repair_success_rate: descriptor-guided repair acceptance under exact checking.
field_principles.speedup_claim_allowed: must remain false without matched timing evidence.
